channel.title: FilePilot Blog
channel.description: Guides to working with PDFs and images privately, in your browser.

item.title: How to Edit a PDF Without Uploading It Anywhere
item.description: How to work with PDFs without sending them to a server: what happens when you upload, which tasks run locally in a browser, and how to verify a tool's claims.

item.title: Is It Safe to Upload a PDF to an Online Tool?
item.description: What happens to a document you upload to a free PDF site, what deletion policies really promise, and how to decide whether uploading a specific file is safe.

item.title: Why Blacking Out Text in a PDF Does Not Redact It
item.description: A black box over text leaves the text in the PDF, still selectable and searchable. How redaction fails, real cases where it did, and how to remove text safely.

item.title: Why Online Forms Reject Your Photo, and How to Fix It
item.description: Government, exam and visa portals reject photos over size, dimensions or format. What each error means, why KB limits exist and how to hit the exact spec.

item.title: What EXIF Data Reveals About Your Photos
item.description: Photos can carry GPS coordinates, timestamps and device serial numbers. What EXIF stores, which platforms strip it, and how to remove it before you share.

item.title: How to Combine Scanned Pages Into One PDF
item.description: Scanners give you one file per page, out of order and too large. How to turn a folder of scans into one clean, ordered PDF without uploading anything.

item.title: How to Compress a PDF Without Wrecking the Quality
item.description: Why PDFs get large, which part of your file is actually taking the space, and the order of operations that shrinks a document without turning the text to mush.

item.title: PDF or CBZ for Comics and Manga?
item.description: Why comic readers prefer CBZ over PDF, what the format actually is, when converting helps, and how page naming decides whether the result reads in order.

item.title: Printing Multiple PDF Pages Per Sheet, Explained
item.description: N-up printing, booklet imposition and poster tiling explained: what each one does, when to use it, and how to get predictable results from any printer.

item.title: Why Your Files Should Never Leave Your Browser
item.description: Uploading files risks breaches and unclear retention. How browser-based processing with WebAssembly and Web Workers keeps documents on your own device.

item.title: The Hidden Privacy Risks of Online PDF Tools
item.description: What really happens when you upload a PDF to an online tool: server storage, metadata exposure, third-party processing, and how to judge if a tool is private.

item.title: How FilePilot Keeps Your Documents Private
item.description: Inside FilePilot's privacy architecture: pdf-lib and WebAssembly, Canvas rendering, ONNX Runtime for AI features, offline support and no server processing.
